reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Scaling up of interventions to combat malaria in Côte d’Ivoire - Côte d'Ivoire (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Côte d'Ivoire, Malaria, Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire (MOH - PNLP)This program has the following goals: Réduire d’au moins 40% le nombre de cas de paludisme (soit de 3 375 526 cas de paludisme en 2015 à moins de 2 025 316 cas) d’ici la fin de 2020. Réduire d’au moins 40% le nombre de décès (soit de 4 385 décès liés au paludisme en 2015 à moins de 2 631 décès) d'ici la fin de 2020. The objectives of this program are: • Accroître de 50,1% en 2016 à 80% en 2020, la proportion de la population qui dort sous une moustiquaire imprégnée d’insecticide d’ici 2020. • Accroître de 46,7 % en 2016 à 80% en 2020, la proportion de femmes enceintes qui prend les deux doses de SP d’ici fin 2020. • Accroître de 22% en 2016 à 40% en 2020, la proportion de femmes enceintes qui prend les trois doses de SP d’ici fin 2020. • D’ici fin 2020, 80% des cas de paludisme sont confirmés et pris en charge selon les directives nationales dans les structures sanitaires publiques et privées ainsi que dans la communauté

Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Malaria test positivity rate
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CIV-M-MOHP02
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics who received three or more doses of intermittent preventive treatment for malaria
Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities during the reporting period
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at private sector sites
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Outcome indicators targets and results for CIV-M-MOHP02
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Percentage of existing ITNs used the previous night
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
